nodes.label: cargo xtask setup
nodes.rationale: Idempotent first-run command: installs the commit-msg hook (core.hooksPath is local to .git/config so it cannot travel in a commit), reconciles declared plugins, and materializes skills. Every run reports what was already correct, so 'already fine' is distinguishable from 'did not look'.

nodes.label: Conventional Commits, No Length Limit
nodes.rationale: type(scope)!: description with an optional multi-part scope. The rule is about shape, not brevity — this project writes long, precise subjects. Rules and their reasoning live in xtask/src/commit.rs.

nodes.label: No AI Attribution Trailers
nodes.rationale: No Co-Authored-By naming a model or vendor, no ...-Session line, no 'Generated with' footer, for any tool. A message ends at its real content; mentioning a vendor in prose is fine and is not what the check matches.

nodes.label: Verification Bar: fast / verify / slice
nodes.rationale: One command, three tiers, the same gates CI runs — what changes is how often you pay. `fast` (~0.3s, compiles nothing) is the pre-commit hook: fmt, check-layers, check-deploy, check-strings. `verify` adds clippy, tests and staleness gates, skipping cargo-deny and the web suite when nothing they inspect moved. `verify slice` forces both on. Nothing is ever dropped.
